sum_pt: Trem de realocação até a Estação Central; inspeção dos Vigilantes, fuga pelos pátios ferroviários e a primeira visão do Trocador.
sum_en: Relocation train to Central Station; Vigilant inspection, escape through the rail yards and the first sight of the Exchanger.
scene: interior of an old Soviet-era passenger train carriage at dusk, worn wooden benches, tired passengers wearing gas masks, through the dirty windows a dried-up seabed and on the far horizon a colossal beetle-shaped atmospheric machine exhaling green smog

sum_pt: Praça monumental com telões do Regente, apartamentos e telhados; encontro com Irina e o Discurso do Ar Puro.
sum_en: Monumental plaza with the Regent's screens, apartments and rooftops; meeting Irina and the Pure Air Speech.
scene: huge brutalist Eastern European city plaza in overcast weather, giant public screens showing a blurred paternal face of a ruler, uniformed riot police with dark visored helmets patrolling, grey apartment blocks, a railway terminal with a glass roof

sum_pt: Fábricas de peças para o Domínio, guindastes, esteiras e a sabotagem da prensa hidráulica.
sum_en: Factories building parts for the Dominion, cranes, conveyors and sabotage of the hydraulic press.
scene: vast industrial factory hall with workers in green hazmat suits at conveyor belts, an overhead gantry crane carrying a platform over a deep pit, a giant hydraulic press, sodium orange lamps, steam

sum_pt: Esgotos, canais e a muralha entre Cidade Nova e Velha; barco a motor perseguido por um helicóptero-caçador e elevador sob holofotes.
sum_en: Sewers, canals and the wall between New and Old City; motorboat chased by a hunter helicopter and an elevator under searchlights.
scene: narrow urban canal at night between tall old buildings, a small motorboat speeding on dark water, an angular armored hunter helicopter with a spotlight chasing it, ahead a gigantic concrete wall with sweeping searchlights and a cargo elevator

sum_pt: O inventor Lindqvist entrega o Manipulador; quebra-cabeças físicos, um cão-robô de sucata e Rastejadores; os planos originais de Tomás.
sum_en: The inventor Lindqvist hands over the Manipulator; physics puzzles, a scrap robot dog and Crawlers; Tomás's original blueprints.
scene: sprawling junkyard under a hazy amber sky, stacked rusted car wrecks, corrugated metal fences, a small brick workshop, an eccentric old inventor with a cane next to an unfinished quadruped robot dog made of scrap, a makeshift dune buggy

sum_pt: Travessia de buggy pelo leito do mar drenado: o petroleiro Aurora, ossadas de baleia, um posto do Domínio e a tempestade de partículas.
sum_en: Buggy crossing of the drained seabed: the tanker Aurora, whale bones, a Dominion outpost and the particle storm.
scene: endless dried seabed desert with dunes, a huge rusted oil tanker lying on its side with a torn hull, giant whale ribcage bones arching over a dirt track, a small dune buggy racing toward a brown particle storm wall, blinking red route beacons

sum_pt: Antiga ilha-presídio virada depósito ferroviário; infiltração noturna pelo farol e pelas docas, torretas automáticas.
sum_en: Former prison island turned rail depot; night infiltration via the lighthouse and docks, automated turrets.
scene: rocky island prison fortress at night rising from a dried seabed, old lighthouse beam, concrete watchtowers, rail tracks leading into fortified gates, automated sentry turrets with red lasers

sum_pt: Resgate dos prisioneiros que seguem para o Trocador; corredores de celas, câmaras de triagem e um alarme geral.
sum_en: Rescue of prisoners bound for the Exchanger; cell corridors, sorting chambers and a general alarm.
scene: long multi-tier prison cell block interior, rusted catwalks, cold fluorescent lights and red alarm lights, prisoners in grey uniforms behind bars, sinister medical sorting chamber with pods in the background

sum_pt: Docas onde naves de transporte do Domínio carregam prisioneiros; combate entre contêineres e fuga num trem de carga.
sum_en: Docks where Dominion transport ships load prisoners; combat among containers and escape on a cargo train.
scene: massive alien-industrial dock hangar with hovering insect-like transport dropships lowering cargo pods, stacked shipping containers, cargo train on rails, soldiers in grey armor, mist and floodlights

sum_pt: Viagem no teto de um trem blindado pelo Ermo; tiroteios em movimento, pontes e túneis.
sum_en: Riding the roof of an armored train across the Wasteland; moving gunfights, bridges and tunnels.
scene: armored freight train crossing a high steel trestle bridge over a dry canyon, figures fighting on the train roofs, smog-green sky, distant beetle-shaped exhaust towers

sum_pt: Aproximação do complexo-besouro; jatos de ar gigantes, conscritos aliados e o Capitão Kovač.
sum_en: Approaching the beetle complex; giant air jets, allied conscripts and Captain Kovač.
scene: colossal biomechanical beetle-shaped atmospheric exchanger complex seen from the ground, segmented metal shell plates, enormous intake vents sucking air with visible vortices, tiny human soldiers in olive uniforms and gas masks for scale

sum_pt: Dentro dos dutos que Tomás projetou: ventiladores colossais, correntes de ar como quebra-cabeça e passarelas.
sum_en: Inside the ducts Tomás designed: colossal fans, air currents as puzzles and catwalks.
scene: inside a gigantic industrial air duct, immense spinning turbine fan blades, narrow catwalks, green smog flowing, a lone engineer with gas mask and wrench, pipes and warning lights

sum_pt: Sabotagem do reator que inicia o levante; o céu limpa por um minuto.
sum_en: Sabotage of the reactor that starts the uprising; the sky clears for one minute.
scene: huge reactor core chamber with a glowing pale blue energy column, collapsing machinery, explosions, through an opening in the roof the smog parts and reveals a clear blue sky for the first time

sum_pt: Fuga pelo litoral em ruínas, vilas de pescadores abandonadas e naves de combate patrulhando.
sum_en: Escape along the ruined coastline, abandoned fishing villages and patrolling gunships.
scene: ruined coastal fishing village on cliffs above a drained sea, burnt wooden houses, stranded boats, a dark angular gunship flying low over the cliffs, grey overcast sky, a broken road

sum_pt: Um quebra-gelo à deriva; tripulação desaparecida, câmaras de contenção e o maquinista Ezequiel.
sum_en: An icebreaker adrift; missing crew, containment chambers and the engineer Ezequiel.
scene: abandoned icebreaker ship stuck in frozen sea ice, red hull with frost, dim deck lights, snowstorm, a strange glowing containment chamber visible through an open cargo hatch

sum_pt: Navegação pelo gelo rumo ao norte; criaturas sob o gelo e uma travessia a pé pelas placas.
sum_en: Sailing north through the ice; creatures beneath the ice and a crossing on foot over the floes.
scene: vast frozen arctic sea at twilight, cracked ice floes, a lone figure walking across with a lantern, huge dark shape of a creature moving beneath translucent ice, icebreaker ship far behind

sum_pt: Base submarina científica; a Dra. Halden recebe o grupo e esconde suas intenções.
sum_en: Underwater science base; Dr. Halden welcomes the group and hides her intentions.
scene: retro-futuristic Soviet underwater research station interior, round porthole windows showing dark ocean, laboratories with pressure doors, cold white lights, a woman scientist in a long coat

sum_pt: Halden trai a Resistência e inunda a base; Ezequiel se sacrifica; fuga em cápsula.
sum_en: Halden betrays the Resistance and floods the base; Ezequiel sacrifices himself; escape pod.
scene: underwater base corridor flooding violently, water bursting through cracked bulkheads, red emergency lights, an escape pod hatch glowing at the end, sparks

sum_pt: Controle climático ártico do Domínio; infiltração em uma cúpula gigantesca sobre o gelo.
sum_en: The Dominion's arctic climate control; infiltrating a gigantic dome on the ice.
scene: gigantic geodesic dome structure on an arctic ice plain, glowing seams, massive pipelines, blizzard, small figures approaching on snowmobiles, aurora in the sky

sum_pt: Batalha ao lado dos Conscritos de Kovač para roubar um avião de transporte.
sum_en: Battle alongside Kovač's Conscripts to steal a transport plane.
scene: huge frozen military hangar, an old four-engine propeller transport plane, soldiers in olive greatcoats and gas masks fighting grey-armored troops, snow blowing through open hangar doors, flares

sum_pt: O avião é abatido sobre a Cidade Nove e cai num arranha-céu stalinista.
sum_en: The plane is shot down over City Nine and crashes into a Stalinist skyscraper.
scene: burning transport plane crashing into a towering Stalinist wedding-cake skyscraper at night, city below in smog with fires, searchlights crossing the sky

sum_pt: Descida pelos andares destruídos do arranha-céu, entre destroços e milícias.
sum_en: Descent through the shattered floors of the skyscraper, among wreckage and militias.
scene: interior of a damaged Stalinist skyscraper, collapsed floors, marble columns, airplane wreckage embedded in the walls, view down an exposed shaft to the city streets far below, dust and fire

sum_pt: O levante toma a Cidade Nove; barricadas, cidadãos armados e blindados do Domínio.
sum_en: The uprising engulfs City Nine; barricades, armed citizens and Dominion armor.
scene: street battle in a grey Eastern European city avenue, citizens with rifles behind barricades of cars and furniture, armored walking war machine on long legs in the distance, smoke, burning tram

sum_pt: Retorno aos canais da Cidade Velha; caçada a uma máquina andante de pernas longas.
sum_en: Return to the Old City canals; hunting a long-legged walking machine.
scene: old city canal district at dusk, a towering three-legged alien walker machine stepping over bridges, resistance fighters on rooftops with rocket launchers, water reflecting fires

sum_pt: Hospital convertido em centro de conversão; resgate de médicos da Resistência.
sum_en: Hospital converted into a conversion center; rescuing Resistance doctors.
scene: decaying hospital corridor converted into a sinister processing center, operating tables with cables, flickering green lights, gurneys, alien machinery grafted onto walls

sum_pt: De volta à estação onde tudo começou; tomar o centro ferroviário para levar o levante à torre.
sum_en: Back to the station where it all began; seizing the rail hub to carry the uprising to the tower.
scene: vast ornate railway station hall with broken glass roof, trains derailed, resistance fighters raising a makeshift flag, morning light through smoke, giant screens cracked

sum_pt: Avenidas monumentais guardadas pelos Arcontes; a Torre do Regente domina o horizonte.
sum_en: Monumental avenues guarded by the Archons; the Regent's Tower dominates the skyline.
scene: monumental government avenue with colossal statues and banners, a gigantic dark spire tower ahead piercing smog clouds, tall robed alien guardians with glowing eyes, ruined parade stands

sum_pt: Invasão da base da torre; elevadores de carga, salas de máquinas e a guarda de elite.
sum_en: Storming the tower's base; freight elevators, machine rooms and the elite guard.
scene: inside the base of a colossal dark tower, cathedral-like machine hall, freight elevators going up into darkness, elite soldiers in black armor with red visors, cables and energy conduits

sum_pt: Ascensão final; confronto com Halden (poupar ou não) e com o Regente.
sum_en: Final ascent; confrontation with Halden (spare her or not) and the Regent.
scene: top chamber of a dark tower above the clouds, a throne-like control room with large screens, an old paternal man in a grey suit standing before a window, storm outside, lightning

sum_pt: Desligar o Trocador-mãe; o primeiro amanhecer sem máscara. Epílogo e créditos.
sum_en: Shut down the Mother Exchanger; the first dawn without a mask. Epilogue and credits.
scene: enormous beetle-shaped atmospheric machine shutting down with its vents going dark, the green smog dissipating, golden sunrise breaking over a ruined city, people removing gas masks on a rooftop
